objective.value: Provide a full e-commerce path for gaming products: browse and filter catalog, cart and orders, reviews, and admin inventory/order management.

repositoryNote.value: Public repository README documents JWT auth, Redis sessions, Stripe payments, Sequelize/PostgreSQL, and React 18 + Vite frontend.

problem.value: Sell and administer gaming products online with authentication, catalog, cart, orders, reviews, and inventory tracking as one application rather than disconnected demos.

overview.value: E-commerce system for gaming products: user auth (including Google OAuth support per README), product browse/filter, cart, orders, reviews, and an admin dashboard for products, orders, users, categories, and inventory. Identity-confirmed core stack is React, Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL.

architecture.value: Node/Express backend with PostgreSQL (Sequelize), JWT authentication, Redis session storage, Stripe payments, and file upload/image processing. React 18 + TypeScript + Vite frontend with Tailwind; React Query for data fetching and Zustand for client state (per repository README).

decisions.value: Token-based JWT authentication with Redis-backed sessions for scalable session handling; Stripe for payment processing rather than custom payment plumbing (per repository README).

constraints.value: Local setup requires Node.js 18+, PostgreSQL 12+, and Redis 6+ (per repository README).
